subject: Request: invoice-only onboarding for Microsub Labs (small vendor)
messages:

To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Subject: Request: invoice-only onboarding for Microsub Labs (small vendor)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the intro earlier this week — excited to get Microsub integrated with Redwood for our usage-based indexing feature. We are a very small shop and will likely issue 1–2 small invoices per month (under $1,000 each).

We completed the vendor intake form and attached a W-9 and our standard MSA. Given our expected volume, our procurement team asked whether Redwood can onboard us on an invoice-only path (no PO). This would simplify our billing and speed the test.

Attachments: microsub_w9.pdf, microsub_msa.pdf, sample-invoice-001.pdf

Would you be able to confirm whether Redwood allows invoice-only onboarding for microvendors or if we need a PO? Happy to provide any additional paperwork.

Best,
Eli Turner
Head of Partnerships
Microsub Labs
eli@microsub.io

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:07:00 -0800

Hi Eli — thanks for the docs and the quick turnaround. I’ve looped in Marissa from ProcureOps to confirm whether an exception is possible for small-dollar partners.

Marissa — Microsub is under $1k/invoice expected, low risk, US-based, provided W-9 and signed MSA. Can ProcureOps approve an invoice-only onboarding (no PO) for this profile? If not, what minimal steps (one-time PO? vendor portal token?) will satisfy Finance to let us bill them quickly?

I’ll characterize this as a trial partner — speed to invoice is the priority.

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Eli Turner <eli@microsub.io>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only onboarding for Microsub Labs (small vendor)

Hi all — quick note on process and recommended path. Thank you for the attachments, Eli — that helps.

Policy background: Redwood requires a PO for recurring contractual spend by default. However, we maintain a documented exception process for low-risk, low-dollar vendors where the Procurement Manager can provision a temporary invoice-only workflow for up to 90 days while we collect final vendor setup items in the background. The exception requires:
- Procurement sign-off (this thread + Jira ticket)
- Finance acceptance of the payment terms and tax docs
- One-time intake entry in vendor portal for remittance details (we can do this from Procurement side)

Action items I propose:
1) Aditya (Finance) — please confirm whether Accounts Payable will accept invoices from Microsub without a PO for amounts < $1,000 and whether we need any payment holdback or review.
2) Diego — please confirm expected invoice cadence and provide final customer billing contact.
3) Eli — if you can confirm the remit-to address and the email where invoices should be sent (AP@microsub.io or billing@microsub.io), Procurement can spin up an invoice-only token and get them into the portal.

I’m opening PROC-1427 for traceability and attaching the minimum-exception checklist. If Finance signs off, I can approve a 90-day invoice-only onboarding and we’ll require the vendor portal entry within 30 days.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proc-exception-checklist.pdf]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Eli Turner <eli@microsub.io>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: invoice-only onboarding for Microsub Labs (small vendor)

Thanks Marissa — Finance reviewed the W-9 and sample invoice. AP is comfortable accepting invoices without a PO for vendors with monthly expected spend under $2,000 provided:
- Vendor W-9 on file
- MSA reviewed for payment terms (Net 30 standard OK)
- Procurement opens a Jira ticket and records the exception reason and owner

We don’t require holdbacks but will flag the first two invoices for manual approval to confirm invoice details. After that, normal routing.

Eli — please confirm billing email and invoice cadence. Once you confirm, Marissa, can you create PROC-1427 and mark the vendor as invoice-only for 90 days? Diego, I’ll flag AP to expect the first invoice for manual clearance.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Finance — Accounts Payable, Redwood Inference
